name: The Escape
storyline: You wake up trapped inside a decaying facility with no memory of how you got there. The only way forward is through locked doors, hidden keys, and cryptic puzzles. Every room hides both a clue and a threat, and the deeper you go, the heavier the silence becomes. In The Escape, survival depends not on combat, but on your ability to observe, think, and make the right choices before the darkness closes in.
summary: The Escape is an unconventional first-person escape room experience. Explore dark, abandoned rooms, search for keys, solve puzzles, and find your way out. Simple to learn but full of tension, it’s designed for short, intense sessions and perfect for streaming or sharing reactions.
